title: Sauerbraten Casserole
description: A German-inspired casserole recipe featuring a tender beef sauerbraten filling, topped with a crispy rapeseed oil crust.
instructions: Brown beef cubes in a skillet over medium-high heat, then set aside.
In the same skillet, add caramelized onions and cook for 2 minutes.
Add beef broth, bring to a simmer, and cook for 5 minutes.
Transfer the beef mixture to the casserole dish.
Arrange diced potatoes on top of the beef mixture.
Place the casserole dish in the preheated oven and bake for 1 hour.
Meanwhile, whisk together rapeseed oil and a pinch of salt.
Brush the rapeseed oil mixture over the crust of the casserole.
Return the casserole to the oven and bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Let the casserole rest for 10 minutes before serving.
